requirements.text: Deploy apps/web as an INTERNAL/dev Render web service from an advisory-free head at or after the M5-T021 Next.js 15.5.24 upgrade: unlisted URL, the unified internal feature flag ENABLED, NEXT_PUBLIC_API_BASE_URL pointed at the existing private API service, internal/dev labeling and the standing disclaimers intact. Contract as normal gated ledger task(s) citing D-043:D-043-R001.
requirements.required_harness: deployed service reachable at the unlisted URL; flag-on address flow resolves a real address end-to-end against the live API
requirements.required_evidence: accepted ledger task(s); owner confirms the live URL works on their device

requirements.text: PRIVACY PRESERVED: the API URL remains private (existing standing rule). The web service's own URL is unlisted and shared only by the owner. No repository file, log, chat message, or client-visible artifact may disclose the private API address beyond the Render environment configuration; the browser bundle carries only the env-injected base URL as already designed.
requirements.required_harness: grep of repo/artifacts for the service URLs; bundle env posture
requirements.required_evidence: no private URL committed or posted; env-only configuration

requirements.text: OWNER-ACTION BOUNDARY: Render dashboard operations (service creation/confirmation, environment variables, any keys incl. Geoclient) are performed or confirmed by the OWNER. The task's return item hands the owner the exact service settings and env-var checklist to apply; credentials never enter repo or chat (Section 20 unchanged).
requirements.required_harness: task return-report checklist; absence of credentials in repo/chat
requirements.required_evidence: owner-applied dashboard settings confirmed in the return report

requirements.text: SCOPE LIMIT: this is NOT a public launch - no public listing, marketing, indexing, or removal of internal/dev posture; the visual redesign remains a separate effort; PR #241, G6, Supabase-before-credentials, and the expansion hold (outside the Packet 3 release) are unchanged.
